title: Global photos taken per year

source.name: Global photo volume estimates
source.publisher: Mylio / Photutorial / PetaPixel annual photo-count compilations

notes: Annual global photo counts as compiled by industry trackers (Mylio/Photutorial/PetaPixel): roughly 1.2 trillion in 2017, climbing past 1.8 trillion by 2023, and expected to exceed 2.1 trillion in 2025. Figures are industry estimates, not a census.
